Trace, implement and test: Kadane Algorithm

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
using System;

public class KadaneAlgorithm {
    public int MaxSubArray(int[] nums) {
        int currentSum = nums[0];
        int maxSum = nums[0];

        for (int i = 1; i < nums.Length; i++) {
            currentSum = Math.Max(nums[i], currentSum + nums[i]);
            maxSum = Math.Max(maxSum, currentSum);
        }
        return maxSum;
    }
}
